e-6074.problem: What is the expected value of one roll of a tetrahedral die?
e-6074.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\textrm E[X] = \sum\limits_{x \in S} x \cdot f(x).
$$

A tetrahedral die has four sides. Let $X$ be the score attained on a random roll of the die. Then the support is $S = \{ 1,2,3,4 \},$ and the corresponding probabilities are all $\dfrac{1}{4}{:}$

$$
f(1) = f(2) = f(3) = f(4) = \dfrac{1}{4}
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3)+4\cdot f(4) \\  & =1(\frac{1}{4})+2(\frac{1}{4})+3(\frac{1}{4})+4(\frac{1}{4}) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}+\frac{2}{4}+\frac{3}{4}+\frac{4}{4} \\  & =\frac{1+2+3+4}{4} \\  & =\frac{10}{4} \\  & =2.5.\end{aligned}
$$

e-7385.problem:
Several children were asked about how many pets they have. The results were recorded below. If $X$ is the number of pets that a randomly selected child has, what is the expected value of $X?$

We're given the frequencies of the number of pets, so we can start by computing the corresponding probabilities. The total number of children is $5+6+5=16,$ so the corresponding probabilities are as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=0)=f(0) & =\frac{5}{16} \\ P(X=1)=f(1) & =\frac{6}{16}=\frac{3}{8} \\ P(X=2)=f(2) & =\frac{5}{16}\end{aligned}
$$

We organize these results in the table below.

| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\dfrac{5}{16}$ | $\dfrac{3}{8}$ | $\dfrac{5}{16}$ |

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Let $X$ be the spin of the fair spinner. Then the support is $S={-2,-1,1,3,5,6},$ and the corresponding probabilities are all $\frac{1}{6}:$

$$
f(-2)=f(-1)=f(1)=f(3)=f(5)=f(6)=\frac{1}{6}
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$

The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Let $X$ be the spin of the fair spinner. Then the support is $S={-2,-1,1,3,5,6},$ and the corresponding probabilities are all $\frac{1}{6}:$

$$
f(-2)=f(-1)=f(1)=f(3)=f(5)=f(6)=\frac{1}{6}
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =(-2)\cdot f(-2)+(-1)\cdot f(-1)+1\cdot f(1)+3\cdot f(3)+5\cdot f(5)+6\cdot f(6) \\  & =(-2)(\frac{1}{6})+(-1)(\frac{1}{6})+1(\frac{1}{6})+3(\frac{1}{6})+5(\frac{1}{6})+6(\frac{1}{6}) \\  & =\frac{-2}{6}+\frac{-1}{6}+\frac{1}{6}+\frac{3}{6}+\frac{5}{6}+\frac{6}{6} \\  & =\frac{-2-1+1+3+5+6}{6} \\  & =\frac{12}{6} \\  & =2.\end{aligned}

after.name: Question 6
after.problem:
The number of heads facing upward after tossing $3$ fair coins follows the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table below. What is the expected value of the number of heads facing upward after tossing the $3$ coins?

| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{3}{8}$ | $\frac{3}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ |
after.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =0\cdot f(0)+1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3) \\  & =0(\frac{1}{8})+1(\frac{3}{8})+2(\frac{3}{8})+3(\frac{1}{8}) \\  & =0+\frac{3}{8}+\frac{6}{8}+\frac{3}{8} \\  & =\frac{0+3+6+3}{8} \\  & =\frac{12}{8} \\  & =\frac{3}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

content.problem:
The absolute difference between the outcomes of one roll of two fair six-sided dice follows the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table below. What is the expected value of the absolute difference of the outcomes for one roll of the two dice?

| $f(x)$ | $\frac{1}{6}$ | $\frac{5}{18}$ | $\frac{4}{18}$ | $\frac{3}{18}$ | $\frac{2}{18}$ | $\frac{1}{18}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ |
content.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =0\cdot f(0)+1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3)+4\cdot f(4)+5\cdot f(5) \\  & =0(\frac{1}{6})+1(\frac{5}{18})+2(\frac{4}{18})+3(\frac{3}{18})+4(\frac{2}{18})+5(\frac{1}{18}) \\  & =0+\frac{5}{18}+\frac{8}{18}+\frac{9}{18}+\frac{8}{18}+\frac{5}{18} \\  & =\frac{0+5+8+9+8+5}{18} \\  & =\frac{35}{18}.\end{aligned}
$$
